title: SDET
description: We are looking for an SDET to own the test automation strategy across our product suite. You will design, build, and maintain end-to-end automation frameworks using Selenium or Playwright with Python. You will integrate automated checks into CI/CD pipelines and drive API-level testing to catch regressions early. If you enjoy finding bugs before customers do and making quality a first-class concern, this role is for you.
